description: This file defines a test suite for the ApiDemos Android application, aggregating multiple tests and suites for comprehensive testing.

classes.name: AllTests
classes.description: A test suite class that consolidates all tests for ApiDemos, utilizing a TestSuiteBuilder to include all packages under the current class.

methods.name: suite
methods.description: Creates and returns a Test suite that includes all tests within this suite, using a TestSuiteBuilder with the current class.
